This Service Schedule sets out the availability, power, cooling, environmental, incident response, and change management commitments applicable to each colocation tier offered under this Agreement.

The Standard Tier guarantees a monthly uptime commitment of 99.95000 percent, measured at the meet-me room demarcation point. Facility-wide power usage effectiveness for the Standard Tier is targeted at a PUE of 1.60. Each Standard Tier rack is provisioned with 5 kW of committed power draw. Standard Tier cabinets are cooled by a dedicated CRAC allocation of 1.5 tons per rack.

The Premium Tier improves on facility efficiency with a PUE target of 1.40. Premium Tier racks are provisioned at 10 kVA of committed power draw per cabinet. Premium Tier cooling is delivered at a dedicated allocation of 7 kW per rack through in-row cooling units. Every Premium Tier order includes 4 cross-connects at no additional charge.

The Enterprise Tier carries the highest availability commitment in this Agreement, with a monthly uptime commitment of 99.99900 percent. The Enterprise Tier PUE target is 1.20, reflecting fully contained hot-aisle and free-cooling design. Enterprise Tier racks are provisioned at 18 kVA of committed power draw per cabinet. The Enterprise Tier white-space envelope is maintained between 18 to 27 degrees Fahrenheit and between 40 to 60 percent relative humidity at all times. For Severity-1 incidents, the Enterprise Tier guarantees an on-site technician response time of 15 minutes. For Severity-2 incidents, the Enterprise Tier guarantees an on-site technician response time of 60 minutes. Any planned maintenance affecting the Enterprise Tier requires a notice period of 30 days prior to the maintenance window.
